description: This file declares helper functions for extracting various data types (uint64, int64, int, string, bool, double) from XML nodes using libxml2, intended for use in XML parsing within the project.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_uint64
methods.description: Helper to acquire an unsigned 64-bit value from XML.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_int64
methods.description: Helper to acquire a signed 64-bit value from XML.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_int
methods.description: Helper to acquire a signed 32-bit value from XML.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_string
methods.description: Helper to acquire a string value from XML; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_bool
methods.description: Helper to acquire a boolean value from XML.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_double
methods.description: Helper to acquire a double value from XML.
